title: Recitation practice: peer listening with the rubric: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 31 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Recitation practice rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 31. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

questions.q: The teacher recites 79:25 to 26 with two mistakes. Write precise feedback for each.
questions.a: For example: 'ٱللَّهُ should be heavy after the dammah'; 'لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن: merge the tanween into laam, no hum'.

questions.q: Peer rounds in breakout rooms (threes): each pupil recites 79:1 to 32; the others mark the rubric and write feedback in the portal response box.
questions.a: Three rubric sheets completed, each with a strength and a precise target.

questions.q: Extend: choose your own target from the feedback and practise it three times.
Which is the most useful feedback?
questions.a: A) 'In 79:31 مَآءَهَا needs four counts'. Precise: the ayah, the word, the rule, the fix.

questions.q: Think again: What makes feedback useful rather than just 'good job'?
questions.a: It names the exact word and rule, shows the correct way, and is kind.
